findings: formation.type: Change `mixed` to `disputed`. The entry presents competing early analyses of 明 (日+月 and 月+囧), not one supported formation combining distinct types; the window analysis also leaves 囧’s phonetic role disputed. This preserves both accounts without labeling their disagreement a mixed construction. Evidence: X-782d94a9d4850607d32f, X-e45bc7ca7a6df92e2cf6, X-23a89ca53c2de2903f2c.
